Death Girl, better known as Death, is the personification of death/the grim reaper seen in Pearl Jam's "Do the Evolution" music video.
 As Death Girl, she takes the form of a young pale and fairly attractive woman with dark blue hair, earrings and clothes. Though they cannot be seen in the music video, she also wears high heels.
 At certain points she also changes form slightly, modifying her face to that of a skull or a screaming Neanderthal.
 Sexy to creepy, still smash
